text:
Anya: quick sync y'all 11 PT about vendor timeline. focus: H200/H100 slotting, MI300 ETA, Gaudi image freeze, and marketplace listing readiness.
Priya: i can own marketplace tagging and docs. need final SKU list and perf cards by 4/10.
Leo: short update: H100 kernel tweaks merged, H200 perf tests pass on internal bench, B200 still on the older microcode until vendor patch lands.
Sam: marketplace wants a canary region plan. propose US-east -> US-west -> EU then APAC. estimated rollout cadence 24-48h between regions.
Jade: ops can provide 4 Gaudi nodes for validation starting 4/14; we saw a power derate earlier that changed perf by ~6%. will annotate.
hw-bot: vendor reported B200 microcode release scheduled 2024-04-12 03:00 UTC. ticket: VEND-4521. link: https://vendor.example/patch/4521
Anya: embargo suggestion: internal preview 4/18, embargo 4/20-4/21, public 4/21 08:00 PT. does that work?
Priya: yes for PR cadence. please keep messaging "staged availability" per vendor ask. avoid inventory language.
Leo: uploaded compatibility matrix: s3://redwood/compat/2024-04-hw-matrix.csv. includes MI300/H200/H100/Gaudi/B200 rows.
Sam: grabbing matrix. i'll wire into pipeline and create a canary market route: `routes.canary=true` and `rate_limit=100qps` for 4/18 smoke.
Jade: ops note: add a perf disclaimer for Gaudi: "measured under a conservative power profile; live numbers may vary". also will post runbook link after thread.
Anya: fallback plan: if MI300 slips, we'll prioritize H200-verified variants and update marketplace tags to route customers to H200 images.
Priya: blockers list by EOD pls. current: B200 firmware timeline, Gaudi power variance, final SKU consolidation.
Leo: action: i'll chase vendor on microcode ETA and share test run logs.
hw-bot: pinging vendor_contacts@vendor.com for microcode ETA. created ticket VEND-4521 and subscribed this thread.
Sam: i'll start rollout config: `region_priority: ["us-east","us-west","eu","apac"]`, initial concurrency cap=200, fallback_model=small-open.
Jade: ops will publish image tags: `gaudi:v1-derate-note`, `h200:prod-202404`. posting links soon.
Anya: reconvene tomorrow 09:00 PT to confirm gates. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
